enunciado: With nested loops draw a right triangle of 4 rows with '*' and then a centered triangle (pyramid) of 4 rows using spaces and '*'.
objetivos: Relate the row number to the number of symbols
pistas: The outer loop goes through rows; the inner one, through columns.
Row f (from 1) of the triangle has f stars.
In the pyramid, row f has N - f spaces and 2f - 1 stars.
